title: Migraine: Symptoms, Causes, Triggers and When a Headache Is an Emergency
seoDescription: Migraine attacks last 4–72 hours with nausea and light sensitivity. Learn the symptoms, phases, causes, triggers and which headaches need urgent care.
excerpt: The doctor's checklist for migraine, its four phases, a side-by-side table against tension, cluster and sinus headaches, why too many painkillers backfire, and the red-flag signs that need hospital care.
